newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Russia ratify extradition treaty.
newsitem.headline: China, Russia ratify extradition treaty.

text.p: China and Russia have formally ratified an extradition treaty, a Russian embassy official said on Friday.
The official said the treaty, already approved by the parliaments of the two countries, would go into effect on January 10.

This was China's first such treaty, the official said, adding that growing commercial ties between the two countries had created a need for exchanges of prisoners, particularly those held for economic crimes.
The agreement was signed during the visit of a Russian government delegation, led by First Deputy Prime Minister Alexei Bolshakov.
The delegation was also participating in a meeting of a Sino-Russian committee for trade and economic cooperation.
